coordinateContract.requiredInput: aligned DICOM series with explicit ImagePositionPatient, ImageOrientationPatient, and PixelSpacing

selectionProtocol.landmarkMethod: manually identify the radiocarpal joint center on the aligned anatomical source before segmentation; record the source instance and patient-space point
selectionProtocol.sliceNormalRequirement: all selected source instances must pass ph_dicom.validate_and_sort_series

longitudinalBounds.proximal: include source slices through at least 120 mm proximal to the radiocarpal-joint-center along the validated series slice-normal direction
longitudinalBounds.distal: include source slices through at least 30 mm distal to the radiocarpal-joint-center along the validated series slice-normal direction
longitudinalBounds.reason: bounded engineering ROI for distal forearm/wrist authoring; these distances define crop scope and are not anatomical-accuracy claims

inPlaneBounds.method: smallest single rectangular pixel crop containing the complete left-limb skin envelope on every selected slice, expanded by 15 mm on each in-plane side
inPlaneBounds.reason: retain local context while keeping the runtime/authoring region bounded; the margin is an engineering crop margin, not a medical measurement

selectionProtocol.outputMethod: record selected SOP Instance UIDs and PixelCrop, then compute the exact patient-space AABB with ph_dicom.patient_extent_for_crop

blockingChecks: source archive bytes are acquired and SHA-256 recorded
candidate cryosection series has an explicit documented alignment state
left laterality is verified from source orientation rather than filename inference
required source instances contain usable DICOM patient geometry
FrameOfReferenceUID is internally consistent when supplied
required vessel visibility is reviewed before draft segmentation promotion
knownSourceConstraint: The original Visible Human Female cryosection sequence contains transverse-plane offsets, and the source CT is not automatically a precise registration target for the cryosections. Raw filename-derived coordinates therefore do not satisfy this ROI's patient-space contract.
completionCondition: Replace all null/empty coordinateContract fields with values measured from the acquired, explicitly aligned source series and retain the resulting source archive hashes. Until then this record is reproducible protocol metadata, not a claim that an exact patient-space extent has been measured.
